title: Mobile-first dark fantasy MMORPG — ~100% AI-generated assets, vibecoded with Claude
author: Particular-Let9884
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev! I've been building **Path of Visions**, a dark fantasy MMORPG / action-RPG designed **for mobile first** — it runs straight in your phone's browser, no install, no app store. Just open the link and play (works on desktop too).

**🎮 Play here:** [https://breezy-fox-945.higgsfield.gg/](https://breezy-fox-945.higgsfield.gg/)

**What's in the game:**

* 7 zones to explore (haunted gallery, gothic vampire moonfall, inferno…) with parallax + ambient life (bats, embers, fireflies)
* First-person combat: tap to strike, block, drink potions
* Online capital hub: meet other players in real time, chat, co-op dungeons & boss raids
* Camp building: deco shop with gameplay bonuses, cooking, fishing, an alchemy cauldron with its own brewing mini-games
* Cloud saves via account (optional — you can play as guest)

*(More visuals:* u/izaivisions *on Instagram)*

comments.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
comments.body:
Is it playable in browser??

I am currently building a game portal similar to miniclip. newgrounds, kongregate with games from indie devs and solo creators. Would love to have your game included. It can be a link that allows iframe embed or I can send you the upload portal for file upload.

replies.author: Particular-Let9884
replies.body:
Yes, absolutely! It’s playable directly in browser.

The gameplay is mainly designed for mobile browser, but it also works on PC. The game is built in a 9:16 vertical format, so it’s optimized for phones, but still playable on desktop.

Your portal sounds really cool, I’d be happy to share a link/build when it’s ready.
